ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 45:55 distribution of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels. White pixels are concentrated at the distal lobe regions, while black pixels dominate the central peduncle attachment and axial regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized, solid black pigmentation extending from the notch toward the mid-sections of both lobes. Lateral zones exhibit high-intensity white backgrounds with high-frequency black speckling and irregular mottling, most dense at the interior boundaries of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 48 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge. Numerous distinct peaks and valleys are visible, particularly on the outer third of both lobes, resulting in a jagged, non-linear boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge, sweeping upward toward tapered, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible, circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated along the extreme lateral edges and tips of both lobes. Numerous dark-ringed circular marks visible within the white fields of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) oriented diagonally on the right lobe's white surface. Multiple shorter, horizontal linear marks present on the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips; significant dark scarification on the upper white field of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-density black speckling pattern ('salt and pepper' effect) located on the interior lower-left and lower-right portions of the white fields.
